molanko_status.command_description: Display Molanko server system information including CPU, memory usage and Discord API latency
molanko_status.error_psutil: The `psutil` library is not installed. Please install it to use this command.
mcavatar.param.player: Minecraft username to use (optional if image is provided)
mcavatar.param.image: Skin image attachment (optional if player is provided)
mcavatar.param.outline_color: Outline color: auto / auto_darker / auto_lighter or hex (#000000)
mcavatar.param.bg_color: Background color: auto / auto_lighter / auto_darker or hex (#ffffff)
mcavatar.param.average_color: Average color for auto outline/bg: hex (#ff0000) or auto
mcavatar.error.need_player_or_image: You must provide either a player name or an image attachment.
mcavatar.error.invalid_average_color: Invalid average_color format. Use hex like #ff0000 or #f00.
mcavatar.error.script_not_found: Internal error: Node.js script not found. Please contact admin.
spritesheet.command_description: Extract frames from a spritesheet as GIF or WebP
spritesheet.param.frame_width: Width of each frame in pixels (default 32)
spritesheet.param.frame_height: Height of each frame in pixels (default 32)
spritesheet.param.cols: Columns (frames per row); auto if omitted
spritesheet.param.rows: Number of rows; auto if omitted
spritesheet.param.end_frame: Last frame index (inclusive); omit for all
spritesheet.param.format: Output format: gif or webp (default gif)
spritesheet.context.prompt: Select output format, then click **Next** to continue.
spritesheet.modal.title: Spritesheet Settings
spritesheet.error.invalid_image: Please upload a valid image file.
mcskin.command_description: Fetch a Minecraft player's face or full skin image
mcskin.param.player: Minecraft username or UUID (with or without hyphens)
og.command_description: Fetch Open Graph Protocol metadata from a URL
og.param.url: The URL to extract Open Graph data from
og.embed.title: Open Graph Metadata
og.field.title: Title
gif_to_spritesheet.command_description: Convert an animated GIF into a spritesheet PNG
gif_to_spritesheet.param.max_width: Max width in px (optional; used when cols=0)
gif_to_spritesheet.error.max_width_min: max_width must be at least 1 pixel.
gif_to_spritesheet.error.invalid_image: Please upload a valid image file.
mcmotd.command_description: Get Minecraft server MOTD, version, and player count
mcmotd.param.server: Minecraft Java server address, e.g. play.example.com:25565
mcmotd.error.empty_address: Please provide a Minecraft server address.
mcmotd.error.display_failed: Minecraft server was queried successfully, but Discord could not display the result.
mcmotd.embed.title: Minecraft Server Status
screenshot_web.command_description: Capture a whitelisted web page screenshot
screenshot_web.param.url: Website URL or domain to capture, e.g. github.com
screenshot_web.param.width: Width in px 640-1920 (default 1400); ignored if preset set
screenshot_web.param.height: Height in px 480-1080 (default 900); ignored if preset set
screenshot_web.param.full_page: Capture the entire scrollable page (default False)
screenshot_web.param.scale: Device pixel ratio 0.1-5.0; preset may set default
screenshot_web.param.block_media: Force block images/videos; else use default policy
screenshot_web.error.domain_not_allowed: This domain is not allowed by the whitelist/blacklist policy.
screenshot_web.error.private_ip: Access to private IP addresses is not allowed (resolved {hostname} -> {ip})
screenshot_web.error.redirect_not_allowe: Redirected URL '{url}' is not allowed by whitelist/blacklist policy.
screenshot_web.error.fullpage_not_allowe: Full-page screenshot is not allowed for '{url}'. Please use a domain from the full-page whitelist.
screenshot_web.error.redirect_private_ip: Redirected URL resolved to private IP address: {hostname} -> {ip}
language.command_description: Set the language for bot replies to you
quote.command_description: Turn a message into a quote image
quote.param.message_id: Message ID to quote (optional if you reply to a message)
quote.param.theme: Theme: dark / light / color / portrait / portrait-light
quote.error.need_message: Provide a message_id, or use the message context menu (Apps → Make it a Quote).
quote.error.message_not_found: Could not find that message. Check the message ID and channel.
quote.error.no_content: That message has no text content to quote.
quote.error.script_not_found: Internal error: Node.js script not found. Please contact admin.
quote.error.no_send_permission: ⚠️ Cannot post in this channel (missing Send Messages / Access).

badge.command_description: Generate a Devins Badge via the Badgeworks API
badge.param.preset_key: Preset icon key, e.g. github, discord, python
badge.param.show_disk: Show a background disk behind the logo
badge.param.fa_icon: FontAwesome icon class, e.g. fa-brands fa-github
badge.param.extra: Extra options as key=value pairs, e.g. bgStops=#e05a47 bgGradPreset=fire
badge.error.unauthorized: ❌ Invalid or missing Badgeworks API key.
badge.error.invalid_response: ❌ Badgeworks API returned an invalid response (missing SVG).
badge.error.connection: ❌ Could not reach the Badgeworks API: {error}
